root_cause.text: The code used an outdated config macro name (CONFIG_CFI_CLANG) instead of the renamed CONFIG_CFI, causing the CFI type-checking for destructor kfuncs to be silently compiled out and thus remain ineffective.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_CFI_CLANG)` to `IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_CFI)` in kernel/bpf/btf.c, and the commit message states: "Using the wrong name results in the code getting compiled out. Meaning the CFI failures for btf_dtor_kfunc_t would still trigger."
